title: Checklist action must not inherit generic session action
type: cumulative patch-only ZIP; not a full release
finding: When a matching component checklist row exists but its actionType is missing, componentAction previously fell back to the session root action. In multi-component service sessions this could falsely assign a replacement action to another component and create a false replacement baseline.
fix: A matching checklist row is authoritative. Missing action on that row remains unknown; session-level action is used only when no matching component checklist row exists.
